usage: - Refers to work done in an office or by office staff; it sounds a bit formal and is usually used in workplace contexts.
- Often appears in phrases like 辦公室, 辦公時間, or 辦公地點, where it describes office-related work or settings.
- You can use it when talking about going to work, handling paperwork, or doing desk-based tasks at a company.
- As a noun, it is commonly used in compounds rather than standing alone in casual speech.
